text:
maria: Heads-up — we need quota + capacity reservation for an upcoming perf run next week. Targets: 12x NDv4as_v5 in eastus2 and fallback 6x NCv3 in westeurope. Also need regional networking bumps (NICs, public IPs, LB backend pool). Deadline: 2026-03-26 EOD. Anyone able to escalate with Azure? Need reservation + quota increases (GPUs, vCPUs, public IPs).

sam: on it. I'll open an elevated support request and ask for a capacity reservation. Can you paste the subscription id and the exact reservation window? Also run this first to capture current usage: `az vm list-usage --location eastus2 --output table`

maria: sub: SUB-REDACTED-0ab1. Window: 2026-03-24 -> 2026-04-07. GPUs: target 12 NDv4s, fallback 6 NCv3. Networking: increase NICs by 50 and public IPs by 30. App team will run a 48-hr stress from 03/25.

sam: filed SR 2100345678 with Azure CSE and flagged for escalation (priority: Standard -> requested elevated). Included capacity reservation request + quota raise. Asked for provisional capacity hold while they validate. Portal link sent to case (masked).

azure-support-bot: Automated: SR 2100345678 acknowledged. CSE assigned: case owner Prakash K. Expected initial reply within 4 business hours. Please provide quota usage screenshot and exact VM SKUs.

maria: uploaded screenshots and az vm list-usage output to the case. SKUs: Standard_NDv4as_v5 and Standard_NCv3. Note: we can accept NDv4 partials if full 12 not available — mixing NDv4 + NCv3 is acceptable as fallback but prefer same-AZ for baseline.

prakash (azure): Hi team — reviewing now. Quick clarification: do you need subscription-level GPU quota increase or region-level? Also network limits: are those per subscription or per vnet? Please confirm vnet name and resource group for eastus2.

sam: replied to Prakash: region-level for eastus2 and westeurope. vnet: prod-inference-eastus2-rg / prod-infer-vnet-eastus2. Provided service tags and current NIC counts.

jake: FYI — if Azure can't commit, we can use Dedicated capacity pool for the run (more expensive but predictable). Also propose splitting test across regions if single-AZ allocation fails.

anna: For the KV-cache and latency baselines we actually need at least 10 ND GPUs in the same AZ. Splitting will change perf characteristics. Please push for same-AZ allocation.

prakash (azure): Update: SR escalated to capacity team. Initial availability in eastus2 is constrained for March. We can reserve 8 NDv4 in eastus2 and offer 6 NCv3 in westeurope as fallback. Network quotas can be raised: NICs +50, Public IPs +30. Target completion: 2026-03-23 18:00 UTC. Requesting sign-off to proceed with partial reservation.

maria: sign-off to proceed with partial reservation (8 NDv4 eastus2 + 6 NCv3 westeurope). Sam — please ask for reservation ID and quota confirmation, and request the change window avoid our nightly backups.

sam: requested reservation id and asked for completion before 03/24 08:00 UTC. Pushed for higher priority due to external demo. Also asked for a cost estimate for the reserved capacity.

azure-support-bot: SR 2100345678 updated: Capacity reservation created — Reservation ID: R-202603231234. Reserved SKUs: 8x Standard_NDv4as_v5 (eastus2) and 6x Standard_NCv3 (westeurope). Quotas updated: GPUs +14, NICs +50, Public IPs +30. Effective 2026-03-23 10:12 UTC. Please validate by provisioning VMs.

maria: confirmed I was able to create 8 NDv4 instances in eastus2 and 6 NCv3 in westeurope. Running smoke tests now. Thanks everyone.

jake: added runbook note: infra/runbooks/azure/quota_and_reservation.md updated with SR 2100345678 and Reservation ID R-202603231234.

anna: starting the 48-hr stress at 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC. I'll post perf numbers to #eng-ml when available.

maria: closing loop — marking as resolved in our tracker. If any failures during stress ping @sam. :thumbsup:
